notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Memnite.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite, adding {1}.
When Memnite dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Memnite to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Unicorn, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Memnite.
Repeat.
